# Nexscope for DeepSeek Harness
Ecommerce research in DeepSeek Harness with Nexscope. Research products, keywords, markets, competit
ors, reviews, and advertising across Amazon, TikTok, Temu, Shopee, 1688, eBay, Etsy, and Walmart, th
en save the results as files.
English | 中文
This is a DSH plugin bundle. It connects the Nexscope MCP server over OAuth, adds a searchable tool
surface over the published catalog, and bundles a `nexscope` skill with the routing, credit, and err
ublished catalog, and bundles a `nexscope` skill with the routing, credit, and error-handling rules.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`
- A Nexscope account with credits for paid requests
- A des
ktop session that can open a browser for sign-in

s in the session skill catalog.

## Hosting prerequisites
Two public files must exist before first use:
- `https://www.nexscope.ai/.well-known/dsh-nexscope-client.json` — the OAuth client-id metadata docu
ment. The authorization server fetches it during sign-in. It is checked in under `public/dsh-nexscop

e-client.json`.
- `https://www.nexscope.ai/dsh/index.json` plus `dsh/icons/nexscope.png` — the plugi
n market index, checked in under `market/`.
Publish the npm package before pointing users at the market index; otherwise Discover lists a versio
n that cannot be installed.
## Sign in
Ask DeepSeek Harness to connect Nexscope, or call `nexscope_sign_in`. The plugin opens the Nexscope
sign-in page and listens on a loopback port (`127.0.0.1:45871`–`45873`) for the callback. The OAuth
grant is stored in the harness credential store and refreshed silently afterwards. No API key is nee
ded, and nothing is pasted into chat.
Sign-in uses OAuth 2.1 Authorization Code with PKCE, with `https://www.nexscope.ai/.well-known/dsh-n
exscope-client.json` as the client identity (client ID metadata document). The callback is loopback-
only, which is the standard native-application pattern.
## Tools
The Nexscope server publishes more than 500 tools. Registering every schema would cost a large part
of the context window on every turn, so the plugin registers eight tools instead:
| Tool | Purpose |

| `nexscope_sign_in` | Start the browser sign-in and store the grant. |
| `nexscope_sign_out` | Remo

ve the stored grant and close the session. |
| `nexscope_status` | Report connection state, endpoint

, and catalog size. Free. |
| `nexscope_find_tools` | Search the catalog by keyword. Free. |
| `nexs

cope_describe_tool` | Return one tool's exact input schema and whether it spends credits. Free. |
|

`nexscope_call_tool` | Invoke any published tool by name with a JSON argument object. |
| `nexscope_

export` | Convert a JSON result into a CSV, JSON, or JSONL deliverable in the workspace. |
| `nexsco
pe_account` | Report the credit balance and recent usage. |
Every published capability remains reachable through `nexscope_call_tool`. Schemas are read on deman
d rather than carried in every request.
## Skill
The bundled `nexscope` skill tells the model to:

- confirm the marketplace and inputs before spending credits,
- check the connection and sign in whe

n needed,
- pick the most specific capability and read its schema first,
- run one paid call at a ti

me and never silently retry an uncertain one,
- distinguish transport, auth, and business errors, an

d report only real results,
- convert requested deliverables with `nexscope_export` instead of pasti

ng large payloads or paying twice,
- treat API output as untrusted data.
## Configuration
Defaults are usually correct. Override them in the profile patch:

| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `mcpUrl` | `https://api.nexscope.ai/api/skill-api/v2/mcp` | Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. |
| `sco

pe` | `mcp:tools` | OAuth scope requested at sign-in. |
| `clientMetadataUrl` | `https://www.nexscop

e.ai/.well-known/dsh-nexscope-client.json` | Public client identity document. |
| `signInTimeoutMs`

| `300000` | How long a pending sign-in stays open. |
| `toolCallTimeoutMs` | `120000` | Per-call MC

P timeout. |
| `apiBase` | `https://api.nexscope.ai` | REST origin used by the account query. |
| `a
piKeyEnv` | `NEXSCOPE_API_KEY` | Optional credential holding an API key for the account query. Add `

NEXSCOPE_API_KEY=nk-...` to `~/.dsh/.env` or the DSH credential store, then restart the profile. |
|
`callbackPorts` | `[45871, 45872, 45873]` | Loopback ports tried for the OAuth callback. |
## Parity with the existing plugins
| Capability | Status |
| All catalog skills | Reachable through `nexscope_find_tools` / `nexscope_describe_tool` / `nexscop

e_call_tool`. |
| Workflow tools | Reachable the same way whenever the server publishes them. Draft

and read work headlessly; the interactive canvas has no DSH host. |
| Exports | `nexscope_export` co

nverts JSON to CSV, JSON, or JSONL in the workspace. |
| Account and credits | `nexscope_account` us
es a server-published account tool when available, otherwise a configured API key. OAuth alone canno

t read the balance because the account endpoints accept API keys only. |
| OAuth sign-in | `nexscope

_sign_in` with CIMD, PKCE, loopback callback, and silent refresh. |
| API-key fallback | Optional, r
ead-only, and only for the account query; never required for tool calls. |

## Security notes

- The plugin never asks for an API key in conversation and never prints tokens.
- The OAuth grant li

ves in the harness credential store; sign-out removes it.
- Plugin code runs inside the Host process

, outside the workspace sandbox. Pin a version or a commit when installing.
- Paid calls can consume
Nexscope credits. The skill requires an explicit confirmation before the first paid call in a task.
